oncall-bot: ALERT: routing policy error — elevated 95th latency for text-gen in us-west since 03:12 UTC. Automatic fallback loop detected: requests toggling between us-west-primary -> us-west-fallback -> us-east due to policy mismatch. Some requests are being routed to `gptx-small` (incompatible variant) causing incorrect tokenization and higher errors. Paging on-call.

maria: acked. I'm on it. Paging ash.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident #INC-4928 assigned to @ash

ash: picking this up. quick ask — did anyone deploy routing-config-schema migration in the past hour? I see a flurry of infra deploys.

denise: I merged #4526 (routing-policy-schema) at 02:58 UTC. It removed `preferred_variant` (deprecated) and introduced `variant_precedence` array. I included a compatibility shim but maybe defaults changed. cc @maria

ash: that matches my suspicion. shim might be falling back to empty precedence which the router interprets as "allow any", and older fallback rules map legacy clients to `gptx-small` in us-west-fallback. looking at router logs now.

ash: log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T03:11:42Z router us-west route eval: client=svc-payments, policy=v2, variant_selected=gptx-small, ttl=30ms
2026-03-14T03:11:42Z fallback-manager: attempted fallback -> us-west-fallback (legacy-mapping)
2026-03-14T03:11:43Z router us-west route eval: policy mismatch -> re-evaluate -> choose gptx-small
```

maria: customer-impact? any 5xxs? slow responses only?

ash: most are 200 but with corrupt tokenization for some inputs and high tail latencies (p95 up from 180ms -> 1.2s). CS reporting timeouts for interactive flows. tagging @customer-success to surface.

customer-success: we got two customer tickets (acct: acme, corp: finex). They saw truncated completions and retries. Escalated to SEs. They need ETA.

denise: I can revert the schema merge quickly. But need a controlled rollback — that PR also changed default `route_fallback_order`. If we revert, we return to old defaults which pinned preferred_variant -> `gptx-3b`. Should I roll back? Revert PR #4526?

ash: yes revert immediately. Mitigation plan:
1) revert PR #4526 in config repo (quick rollback)
2) restart router workers in us-west (graceful) to pick up old schema
3) enable temporary routing rule to force `variant_request=redwood-core` for svc-payments

maria: doing step 1 now.

denise: rolling back PR #4526…

oncall-bot: Documentation link: https://runbook.redwood.internal/routing/fallbacks

denise: rollback complete and merged at 03:22 UTC. applying config push.

ash: restarting router workers in us-west with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/router-us-west -n inference` (0 -> 2min drain).

ash: /syslogs show decreasing fallback flips after restart start.

ash: after restart, sample request traces show variant `redwood-core` selected and latency p95 back to ~210ms.

maria: pinging CS with update: "We rolled back a recent routing config change and are seeing p95 return to normal. We're monitoring and will follow up in 30m."

customer-success: got it — passing to customers. They want postmortem and whether this will recur.

ash: root cause summary (short): schema migration removed deprecated `preferred_variant` without preserving default semantics. On schema mismatch, router treated empty precedence as permissive and legacy fallback mappings resolved to `gptx-small`. Fix: revert + patch migration to preserve explicit default precedence and add a strict validation failure instead of permissive default.

maria: next steps:
- denise to open a follow-up PR that enforces a non-empty `variant_precedence` with a validation error
- ash to add a runtime check in router to fail-safe to last-known-good variant instead of permissive
- ops-sre to run a canary validation on staging for schema migrations

denise: opening follow-up PR #4538: add validation, preserve `preferred_variant` mapping, and migration unit tests.

ops-sre: I'll kick off canary validation job and a replay of recent traffic to ensure no regressions.

maria: handing off to ops-sre for monitoring for the next hour. If anything spikes, page the on-call rotation.

ops-sre: ack. I'll keep quiet checks and post updates.

ash: posting quick mitigation commands used:
```
# force route for svc-payments until patch lands
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/overrides" -d '{"service":"svc-payments","variant":"redwood-core","ttl":600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

maria: thanks team. I'll create incident record and draft a customer-facing summary.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4928 severity: sev-2 -> mitigated. Monitoring phase. Assigned: ops-sre.

ops-sre: monitoring shows stable. closing active pager. Will produce postmortem and notify CS.

maria: closing thread for now — follow-up PM will have the postmortem link. :thumbsup:
__notes: Please do not include a human-readable title field per agents.md rules. This file models a Slack thread for an incidents channel about a routing schema change causing fallback loops and wrong model variant selection.
